abstract: We report an example of benign cystic ovarian teratoma that was incidentally discovered in a nulliparous 24-year-old woman taking contraceptive pills. Histological examination of the cyst revealed the presence of prostatelike tissue in association with a wide variety of other tissues. The use of highly specific monoclonal antibodies developed against the two prostate-specific kallikreins (hK2 and hK3) in humans allowed the demonstration that the multiple islets of epithelial cells were prostatic tissue in nature and that only part of these cells had conserved their intrinsic property of producing kallikreins.
abstract_ja: 24歳の未経産女性で、経口避妊薬を服用中に偶然発見された良性の嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫の症例を報告する。組織学的検査では、他の多様な組織とともに前立腺様組織が認められた。ヒトの前立腺特異的カリクレイン（hK2およびhK3）に対して作製された高特異性モノクローナル抗体を用いて、複数の上皮細胞島が前立腺由来であることを示した。これらの細胞のうち一部のみが、本来のカリクレイン産生能を保持していた。
